summary_of_bug: X5455_ExtendedTimestampTest fails on JDK 9 because X5455_ExtendedTimestamp’s Java Date/time conversion does not match the test’s expected second-precision behavior: Java times must reject values beyond 32-bit seconds, truncate milliseconds, preserve exact UTC-second values when converting between Date and ZipLong, and return null consistently when cleared. The bug report indicates JDK 9 changed Date/getTime-related behavior (likely around JDK-8073497), exposing that the implementation or test relied on old assumptions about timestamp conversion and causing incorrect getTime() results in this ZIP extended timestamp path.

There is no shared mechanism or regional proximity beyond being in the same library.
